stem.text: A car of mass $m$ travels at constant speed up a slope at an angle $\theta$ to the horizontal, as shown in the diagram. Air resistance and friction provide a resistive force $F$. The acceleration of free fall is $g$.

stem.alt: Car on an upward slope, with the slope angle θ marked at the base and a resistive force arrow labelled F pointing down the slope.

stem.text: What is the force needed to propel the car at this constant speed?
